evidence.detail: rs/s/e/b directly extends the reviewed PluginPanel base rs/ui/m and stores only the reviewed GpuPlugin plus the plugin-hub/config component factory dependency.

Reviewed GpuPlugin rs/s/e/c obtains rs/s/e/b from the injector, builds a NavigationButton titled exactly 'GPU Mode' with gpu_icon.png, binds rs/s/e/b as that button's PluginPanel, and registers it with ClientUI.

GpuPluginPanel overrides the PluginPanel activation hook J_(): it removes all content, asks the plugin configuration UI factory to build the component for the GpuPlugin instance, and adds that component as the sole panel content.
The class does not own the separate desktop GPU Settings window rs/gui/a/a. Its responsibility is specifically the navigation/sidebar plugin panel for GPU Mode.

proposals.note: GpuPluginPanel is fixed by PluginPanel inheritance, exact GPU Mode navigation registration and its one-purpose rebuild path around the reviewed GpuPlugin. Confidence is 0.999; the dead duplicate GPU enums remain deliberately unnamed.
